feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 18 May 2026 11:17am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Monday, 18 May 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

This afternoon will be dry and bright with sunny spells, as the light southwest wind gradually turns to the south or southeast and starts to freshen. Highs of 13°C.

Turning cloudy this evening as rain arrives from the southwest, turning heavy at times tonight, as the south-easterly wind increases fresh to strong with minimum temperature around 8 or 9°C.


##Outlook##

The rain at first tomorrow will soon clear to allow bright or sunny spells to develop, however scattered showers will continue to affect the island at times during the rest of the day. Quite windy with a fresh to strong south to southwest wind and top temperature around 14°C.

Wednesday will be mostly dry and bright with spells of sunshine, although one or two passing showers are still possible. A moderate to fresh south-westerly wind, with maximum temperature around 15°C.
